content.text: Replace this text and the input_json data with actual validated evidence for this question batch.

questions.name: H01
questions.instructions: How healthy is shop catalog based on active SKUs, missing details and availability? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Severe widespread missing details or stockouts.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Consistent high-quality catalog with good availability and variant hygiene.

questions.name: H02
questions.instructions: How strong are fulfillment outcomes using cancellation, late-shipment and dispute metrics? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: High cancellations/late shipment or unresolved disputes.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Generally reliable fulfillment with modest exceptions.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Consistently reliable fulfillment, low preventable issues.

questions.name: H03
questions.instructions: How effectively does the shop convert relevant visits to orders relative to comparable shops? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Above comparable benchmark with stable evidence.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Strong sustained conversion above peer baseline without misleading attribution.

questions.name: H04
questions.instructions: How efficient is paid acquisition considering spend, attributable revenue and margin? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Spend generates material losses with reliable attribution.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Poor unit economics despite sufficient data.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Sustainable strong incremental profitability with reliable attribution.

questions.name: H05
questions.instructions: How strong are seller reputation and after-sales issue handling? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Predominantly positive feedback, issues generally resolved.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Strong representative ratings and fast transparent remediation.

questions.name: C10
questions.instructions: How easy is purchase given real stock, price, shipping and path information? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Working path, available stock, understandable price and shipping.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Seamless purchase path, clear variant/terms and reliable fulfillment.
